check.reason: The target is the system: payers, providers and vendors automating the same dispute while selling each other tools. The patient is shown as the person left on hold, so the joke is on their side. It has no invented numbers or quotes, no article quotes, no mockery of authors, and no death, children or violence. The headline is a clear satirical extension of the real story about AI payer intelligence in revenue cycle, not a misstatement of it. The tone is dry and deadpan with no emojis or hashtags, and it reads as satire rather than a plain summary.

pick.headline: Hospital Buys Software to Predict Which Insurer Denials It Will Pay Software to Appeal
pick.take: Payers use AI to deny claims. Providers now use AI to anticipate the denials. Everyone is automating the same argument, and the only fixed cost is the invoice for the tools. Meanwhile the patient still waits on hold for a prior authorization that two algorithms have already discussed without them.
